[EN] Allemantheia's destiny has changed over time, but we have always pursued it as one people.

That's the strength of the high elves, you see. We move as one, we learn as one, and we fight as one.
[ES] El destino de Allemantheia ha cambiado con el tiempo, pero siempre lo hemos perseguido como un solo pueblo.

Esa es la fuerza de los high elves, ya ves. Nos movemos como uno, aprendemos como uno y luchamos como uno.
